tools.name: search_usecases
tools.description: Search curated AI use cases using the default hybrid ranking. Use this when an agent has a natural-language search term. Each result has Url (the original public source), HubUrl (the record on aiusecasehub.com) and, where the company has one, CompanyPages (its hub company page).

tools.name: hybrid_search_usecases
tools.description: Search AI use cases with hybrid full-text and vector ranking. Supports provider, industry, geography, technology, customer, partner, and boolean case-type filters. Filters work without a query, for example customer_name alone lists that company's deployments, including spelling variants and units gr

tools.name: vector_search_usecases
tools.description: Semantic vector search for AI use cases using the meaning of the query text. Results carry the same Url, HubUrl and CompanyPages links as the other searches.

tools.name: get_usecase_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed information for a single AI use case by RowKey/id, with its source Url, HubUrl and CompanyPages links.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: What the hub's company page shows for one company: a one-line summary, the maturity stage of its public AI record (0 Nothing public, 1 Self-reported, 2 Early, 3 In production, 4 At scale, with the rule behind it), documented deployments and how many are in production, AI providers, use-case patterns

tools.name: get_ai_trends
tools.description: The hub's trends page as data: the weekly 'who gains, who is under pressure' calls (industries, business models, vendors and listed companies, jobs, countries) with their reasons, confidence, cited evidence and the date each call was first made, plus earlier calls; the fastest-rising use-case patter

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details · Private data: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, get_company_profile · Public sink: get_ai_trends.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details · Private data: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, get_company_profile · Public sink: get_ai_trends

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_usecases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
